inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There were several sleeping mats that were observed torn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required: During the inspection it was observed there was only 1 caregiver present during naptime. There was not another caregiver in the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child in care was observed left alone in the back classroom while the caregiver walked to the front of the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver stated she had 16 children in care and it was determined she had 17 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance: It was determined a caregiver drank an alcoholic beverage during their lunch break and came back to the operation and cared for a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Not Under the Influence of Alcohol or Controlled Substance (26 TAC §746.3703(c))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device (bouncer). The caregiver removed the infant from the bouncer and placed the infant in their crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: An infant was observed in a bouncer without the safety straps fastened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: There were 3 infants feeding instructions that were observed not to be up to date. One had not been signed since March 2026 and the other 2 have not been signed since April 2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: There were 2 groups combined outdoors, the caregivers stated there were19 children and it was determined there were 18 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher was observed to have last been serviced in April of 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection. The last fire inspecton was completed in March 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): 2 out of 7 personnel files were missing affidavit form 2985 and 5 out of 7 personnel files were missing affidavit form 2912.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: During the inspection, there were 2 rocking toys and a slide on the playground that did not have loose fill around it. The caregiver removed the toys from the playground during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: A caregiver informed she had 4 children in care and it was determined she had 3 children in care. The children were all grouped together during outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the inspection, an IPAD was observed being utilized with cartoons showing, while children under 2 years old were in care. The caregiver turned off the IPAD during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During current inspection, there was a broken toys with sharp edges observed in the playground the children were in. The caregiver removed the toy during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy was missing the following sections:Promotion of indoor/outdoor play, Emergency Preparedness Plan, Nursing Mothers, Preventing Responding to Abuse/Neglect, Employee Vaccinations, Procedures for Inclusive Services to Children with Special Needs, Gang Free Zone and Parent Rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Size of Mesh Openings: A play yard was observed to have a hole in the play yard and was bigger than 1/4 inch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Size of Mesh Openings (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(G))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: A child's admission form did not have the parent's signature for the Emergency Authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A parent documented on their child's file that there child had an allergy to peanut butter and there was no documentation of a food allergy plan for review, in the child's file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: 3 out of 7 personnel files did not have documentation of pre-service completed prior to the caregiver being in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: 2 out of 7 personnel files did not have a high school diploma on file for review.-
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: The operation did not have an infant feeding instructions on file for 1 infant. During the inspection, the parent came to sign and complete the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: 4 out of 7 caregivers reviewed, did not have documentation of orientation completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: Based on the evidence from the DFPS investigation, a child in care received an injury that required medical attention, and the caregiver did not provide first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The Director has not ensured the operation is operating in compliance with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: It was determined a caregiver had not completed pre-service prior to being in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant was observed asleep in a crib with a stuffed animal and a blanket. Another infant was observed in a play yard with a pillow
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Based on the evidence from the DFPS investigation, it was determined there was no adequate lighting during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: During an inspection, the playpens were observed to not have snug fitting sheets.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2411(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: It was determined a caregiver had not completed orientation prior to being in a classroom alone.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: A sleeping infant was observed with a bottle in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Upon arriving at the daycare, I observed a television on with cartoons playing and there were children younger than 2 years old in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup: I observed an infant walking around their classroom with a bottle that contained milk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - No Walking or Sleeping with Bottle or Cup (26 TAC §746.2419(7))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers were unaware of the number of children they had in their group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers: A walker was observed being utilized in the operation.   The walker was removed during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Baby Walkers (26 TAC §746.2415(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: It was determined the operation did not report the supervision concern where a child was able to crawl under a fence to an unregulated area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: It was determined a caregiver informed a child they would not a cupcake, during a special occasion celebration, if they continued to cry and would get a regular snack instead.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection, I observed a caregiver leave her classroom to adjacent classroom. There was not another caregiver supervising her children.  In another incident, it was determined a child was able to crawl under a fenced door and get into an area that is not regulated. The area had hazards such as cleaning supplies, tools that could have been a safety risk for the child. The child was able to be removed from the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A 13 month old infant was observed a lone in a classroom during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The operation did not test the smoke detector, carbon monoxide or inspect the fire extinguishers for the month of December 2024.  The smoke detectors and  carbon monoxide detectors were tested during the inspection. The fire extinguishers were observed to be within the proper fill line during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: There was a room the children eat lunch in that did not have a smoke detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §746.5311(a))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation does not have a permit to serve hot meals and was observed heating corn and ravioli for lunch.  The caregiver ordered pizza for lunch during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3405)

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation: The operation's first aid kit was missing a thermometer, tape, antiseptic wipes and gloves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Available in Each Building, on Field Trips, during Transportation (26 TAC §746.4001)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not complete any fire drills for the months of November or December 2024. The operation only completed 3 shelter, severe weather and lock down drills for 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation has not completed the Employees who Left Survey for 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: There were 4 toddlers observed sleeping with a sippy cup. The caregiver removed the cups during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Minimum Qualifications Child Care Center Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit: There were 2 caregivers that did not have affidavits on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: There were 2 caregivers that did not have orientation/pre-service on file, prior to being in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: There was 1 person with a pending background check and 1 person with no background check submitted; both were observed caring for a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The outdoor area had tree branches and debris that was observed throughout the yard. A fence was observed to be broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: A copy of the recent health inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
